_comment: Subagent policy read by the kit's hooks/agent.mjs on every Agent call (DES-11). Tunables only, no logic. adopt copies this into the brain; edit the brain copy, never this template. brief.required: headings a brief must carry at line start, 'A:|B:' means either. brief.lightTypes: agent types that search rather than build and need only brief.lightRequired. brief.sessionTools: the host's session-start tools by full tool name (CTRL-02); on one of these the hook reads the input's prompt as the brief and checks brief.required, and nothing else; the same name must be in the hook's matcher, so a tool added here is added to the matcher in the brain's settings. routes: model by agent type when the call names none; 'inherit' leaves the session model; 'default' covers any type not listed; a route matches the exact type name, there is no wildcard, so a family of agents (council-spark, council-skeptic, ...) is one line per name in the brain copy. cap.perTurn: spawns per turn (session + prompt) before the hook stops and asks; 0 disables the cap.
_voice: Voice: is an optional brief heading, documented and not required (owner ruling 29, 2026-10-20). Template text: 'Voice: terse, for your master, not the owner; no hype, no recap prose.' It tells a work session how to answer its master. It stays out of brief.required because the kit cannot know that every adopter wants a voice line, or has an owner-voice rule to separate from; an adopter who does adds "Voice:" to brief.required in the brain copy. The router's writerSkip key (route-policy.json) is what keeps owner-voice law out of a writer session.
